controls.name: usable full/partial/closed-empty same-run keeps zero-SQL authority
empty and unbound envelopes recover exact positive cache through actual route
failed or stale same-run payload is not treated as a fresh empty sample
cache absent keeps original missing result without provider fallback
failed/empty cached result cannot replace missing with zero
wrong-asset and unbound legacy cache are rejected by the new path
expired cache never becomes a current fact
future cache clock is not closed by lookup time
missing/denied admission, invalid identity/clock and unknown usage stop before SQL
cache query failure keeps refusal and unknown without another query
valid returned cache survives late unknown and actual route stops following work
legacy omitted, array and non-plain envelopes remain unchanged
